description: This PHP class 'MailerSubscriber' is an event subscriber in a Symfony-based application. It listens for the kernel terminate event and, when triggered, checks a cache key to determine if email sending should be processed. If so, it logs the start time, invokes an email queue service to send pending emails, logs the end time and execution duration, and updates the cache to prevent repeated execution.

classes.name: MailerSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for Symfony kernel terminate events. It conditionally triggers sending of pending emails via an email queue service, with comprehensive logging and cache management.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Symfony Kernel terminate event to the 'onTerminateEvent' method.

methods.name: onTerminateEvent
methods.description: Handles the terminate event by checking cache status, logging timestamps, invoking email sending, and updating cache.
